events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, and its impact on global markets is increasing. The conflict has already led to a rise in oil prices and a decline in stock markets. The situation is expected to worsen, leading to higher volatility in the markets.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to higher oil prices, which will negatively impact emerging markets. On the other hand, gold is expected to rise as a safe-haven asset.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Exit the position if the conflict de-escalates or if the oil prices decline

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is expected to hike interest rates to combat inflation. The move will impact the US economy and the stock market.
events.reasoning: The interest rate hike will lead to higher bond yields, making long-term Treasury bonds more attractive. On the other hand, the hike will negatively impact the stock market.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the Fed's decision and adjust the position accordingly

gains.conservativeNote: If the hike is smaller than expected
